landing.title: Master Your Setlist.
landing.subtitle: The all-in-one repertoire manager for individual musicians and bands. Catalog songs, track mastery stages, share setlists, and pull up chords & tabs instantly on stage.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need For Practice & Stage
landing.featuresSubtitle: Designed to stop song knowledge from being scattered across chats and folders.
landing.f1Desc: Catalog songs with title, artist, album, key, cover art, duration, and external links to Spotify, YouTube, or Cifra Club. Songs other musicians have already catalogued arrive pre-filled — title, artist, album, key, cover art and links — so you add them in one tap.
landing.f2Desc: Track song progress with a 5-stage scale: Unknown → Learning → Practicing → Polishing → Mastered.
landing.f3Desc: Create bands, invite members with a link, and give the band a repertoire of its own — its own key, lyrics and readiness, authored by the band rather than guessed from its members.
landing.f4Desc: A mobile-optimized reading mode for music stands. Swipe between songs in a setlist, view lyrics with chord tags, and switch to Stage Mode.
landing.f5Title: Handwritten Notes on PDFs and Photos
landing.f5Desc: Attach PDF chord charts and tablatures to any song, or a photo of the handwritten chart you already play from, yours or shared with your band, and write straight on them in Stage Mode with your finger or a pen. Annotations are saved per page automatically, drawing toggles on and off so you can still turn pages, and it works great on a tablet.
landing.f6Desc: Search songs directly on Spotify and import entire playlists into your personal or band repertoire with one click.
landing.f7Desc: Download a playlist before the gig and read it offline with no signal at all: lyrics, keys, statuses and your PDF charts, straight from the device. The venue basement has no Wi-Fi — your setlist does not care.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Take Your Setlist to the Next Stage?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join Repertoire Hero today and keep your music cataloged, synchronized, and gig-ready.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: We collect the email address you sign up with, the repertoire data you enter (songs, statuses, tags, lyrics, playlists and bands) and the files you upload, such as PDF charts, photos and audio.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Your data is used only to run Repertoire Hero for you and for the bands you join. Your personal data is not sold, and it is not shared with advertisers.

sections.heading: Deleting your data
sections.body: To have your account and everything attached to it deleted, send a request from the email address you signed up with to the contact address of the project owner. We delete the account, its repertoire and its uploaded files on request.
